outcomes.note: AgentDojo format: utility_user_tasks = utility without the injection-task pre-passes; attack_success = security on attacked runs that are not pre-passes (security of a benign run is the runner's constant); the other names are the raw judgements of every run in the arm

prov.unverified_split_rule: statement level: apv:basisRule refs, else the decoded inference-bundle method set; twin = restates a catalogued D rule (D.5.4); native = class-I rule with _unverified in its id; mixed = both (CC-08, 2026-10-15)

redaction.note: account-path matches benchmark fiction too (/home/user in sandboxes): read the pointer; operator-* hits are the operator's own home path or host name and are always findings
